title: Railway custom domain never gets a certificate after the CNAME was set
symptoms: Certificate warning on the custom domain
cause: Each custom domain gets its own CNAME target, which can change, and Railway also requires a TXT verification record. A CNAME pointing at an old target with no TXT never issues a certificate. Some plans cap custom domains at two.
fix: Copy the current CNAME target and the TXT record from the service's domain settings into DNS, and remove unused custom domains if you hit the cap.
apply: DNS: CNAME <sub> -> <hash>.up.railway.app and TXT _railway-verify.<sub> = railway-verify=<value>, both copied from the custom domain panel of the service
